definitions.explanation: Done before the time when something else happens.

examples.japanese: {予|あらかじ}め⟦{予約|よやく}→よやく：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→ひつよう：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: You need to make a reservation in advance.

examples.japanese: {予|あらかじ}め⟦{準備|じゅんび}→じゅんびする：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦しておいた→おく：01092_oku⟧。
{予|あらかじ}めご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→りょうしょう：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: Formal expression often used in notices

notes:
{予|あらかじ}め is an adverb meaning "in advance" or "beforehand," emphasizing preparation before the main event.

WRITING:
Written with {予|あらかじ} (beforehand/in advance). Also commonly written entirely in hiragana: あらかじめ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {予|あらかじ}め + verb: to do something in advance
- {予|あらかじ}め + noun + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→ひつよう：00846_hitsuyou⟧: X is required in advance

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予|あらかじ}め⟦{予約|よやく}する→よやくする：22989_yoyakusuru⟧: to reserve in advance
- {予|あらかじ}め⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→じゅんびする：22427_junbisuru⟧: to prepare beforehand
- {予|あらかじ}めご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→りょうしょう：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Please understand in advance (formal notice)
- {予|あらかじ}め⟦{確認|かくにん}する→かくにんする：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to confirm in advance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前|まえ}もって→まえもって：03765_maemotte⟧: beforehand (casual)
- ⟦{事前|じぜん}に→じぜん：07580_jizen⟧: in advance (formal)

REGISTER:
Slightly formal; common in business, notices, and instructions.
